units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 24b:18">Ab. Zar. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>רוֹנִּי וכ׳</he> rejoice, O holy ark, v. <cite ref="T00374"><he>רוּם</he></cite> I h.

senses.gloss: to murmur, complain. Y. Ber. IV, 7ᵈ top עד שרִינְּנוּ כל העם until all the people murmured (became rebellious); Bab.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 27b:19">Ber. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>שרננו</he>; Y. Taan. IV, 67ᵈ <he>שריננו בו</he>; <cite ref="Bekhorot 36a">Bekh. 36ᵃ</cite>. Y. Ber. IX, 14ᵇ <he>מְרַנְּנִים אחריו</he>, v. <cite ref="O01368"><he>סְפִיקוּלָא</he> I</cite>.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12">Num. R. s. 12<sup>7</sup></cite> <he>כל … לא היתה מְרַנֶּנֶת</he> as long as she was engaged in making the purple cloak, she did not grumble; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 5:1">Pesik. R. s. 5</cite> <he>מרנונית</he> (corr. acc.; Tanḥ. Naso 12 <cite ref="M02657"><he>מריבה</he></cite>). Num. R. l. c.; Pesik. R. l. c. <he>ווי … וִירַּנְּנוּ כשם שהיו מרננים</he> woe, (I am afraid,) lest they will again murmur as they were wont to do.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 33:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXXIII</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Song of Songs 4:11">Cant. IV, 11</cite>) <he>בין משבחת בין מרננת אל תמנעי וכ׳</he> whether praising or complaining, refrain not thy voice, for ‘thy voice is sweet’; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to sing, praise. Ib. הכל מרננים צדיקים מרננים וכ׳ all give praise (to God), the righteous give praise, and the wicked give praise; אבל אין הרשעים מרננין וכ׳ but the wicked praise not until he brings plagues upon them &c. Ib. הכל מרננין לפניו וכ׳ all sing before Him, heaven and earth sing &c.; a. fr.
